name: sandcastle
description: Sandcastle — agent-native software development platform (.NET). Presets for external agents bootstrapping context about the product's capabilities.

presets.title: Product capabilities
presets.summary: Conversations (start-task async), events (durable log), skills, MCP servers, ACP sessions, sandboxes, plans/checkpoints.

presets.title: Agent runtime model
presets.summary: V1 event-sourced runs: POST /app-conversations returns an async start-task (WORKING→READY); agent tools run inside a Docker sandbox; mcp__* tools come from registered MCP servers; declarative agents via *.agent.md in workspace/user/builtin layers.
presets.tools: 34 builtins (file ops, bash, git, worktree, jobs, search, web_fetch, browser, memory, subagents) + MCP-registered tools resolved as mcp__{server}__{tool}.
